scope: Joint request/activity relevance; not constraints, eligibility or registration. Existing CAL queries on four original opportunities calibrate the policy. All earlier EVAL/CONF queries are diagnostic only. Fresh queries test eight candidates, including four unseen source-backed activities. Labels frozen before inference, manually authored by the implementer.
acceptance_rule: No accepted false-positive candidates and at least one accepted relevant candidate for every positive fresh query. Uncertain results are not accepted. No retuning after fresh evaluation.
